consecutiveRateUp6OperatorsOnTheSameBann: Consecutive rate-up 6★ operators on the same banner; an off-banner pull or unknown rate-up pool breaks the streak
each300SavedPullsOnAnIndividualLimitedBa: Each 300 saved pulls on an individual limited banner counts as one spark, then totals are added. This does not indicate actual redemptions
score100AveragePullsPer6ClampedTo0: <part1></part1> Score = 100 − average pulls per 6★, clamped to 0–100. No score is given before the first 6★. The current score covers only saved records from banners that are still open, not the entire game version. It is neither a player ranking nor a prediction of the next pull.
theTitleBesideThePlayerNameUsesTheCurren: The title beside the player name uses the current unrounded score, with one tier per 10 points: <part1></part1>. No saved pulls in the current period shows the green Hoarder title. If pulls exist but no 6★ has appeared, no score title is shown yet.
lifetimeScoresUseTheSameTitlesAndAllSave: Lifetime scores use the same titles and all saved records. Current and lifetime titles share colors: red below 40, yellow from 40 to below 60, and green from 60 to 100. A lifetime score without a 6★ is shown as —.
averagePullsPer6CountsThroughTheLatest6: Average pulls per 6★ counts through the latest 6★, excluding subsequent pity pulls, then divides by the number of 6★ pulls. Standard and Kernel banners each share their own pity; limited, crossover, and special banners are calculated separately. Rate-up averages count each banner through its latest rate-up pull and divide the combined eligible pulls by rate-up 6★ count. Banners without a rate-up pull are excluded. The earliest segment may be incomplete, so averages describe only saved history.
limitedStatisticsIncludeCrossoverBanners: Limited statistics include crossover banners, but each banner is calculated separately without shared pity. Counts include duplicate 6★ operators. Off-banner means a 6★ outside the known rate-up pool; missing pools or unsaved custom rate-ups are marked Unclassified. Kernel category cards show the 6★ average. The lifetime classified off-banner rate is <part1></part1>.
pityCountsAppearOnlyAtTheTopStandardAnd: Pity counts appear only at the top. Standard and Kernel each carry pity across their own banners; limited pity shows only active banners and does not carry between periods. If the previous 6★ is missing, ≥ marks a lower bound. Missing history prevents exact reconstruction. The next-pull base 6★ chance is 2% after 0–49 pulls, 4% after 50, and increases by 2 percentage points per pull until reaching 100% on pull 99. This excludes special target-operator guarantees.
greenAchievementsCountMulti6ResultsInCom: Green achievements count multi-6★ results in complete ten-pulls and consecutive rate-up 6★ operators on one banner. Red spark achievements count each full 300 saved pulls on an individual limited banner, then add totals. Remainders do not combine across banners; Standard, Kernel, crossover, and special banners are excluded. This is a pull-count achievement, not evidence of redemptions or operator Potential.
noCurrent: No saved pulls for the current banners
ratingRule: Site rating: 100 − average pulls per 6★, limited to 0–100.
noCurrentRecords: No saved records for this banner
shared: Shared across banners of this type
unknownUp: {count, plural, one {# unclassified rate-up result} other {# unclassified rate-up results}}
